attack.note: Autos feed Essence Claws, Primal Rage and Feeding Frenzy cooldown cuts, but his kit is Drag and Dark Swarm.

poke.note: Drag is a short skillshot used to catch a target, not to chip.

damage.note: Measured hero damage is only 1466 per minute (below the 2060 median) while siege is 6414 and CC applied is 33.5 seconds per game, so he is more of a catch and control bruiser. Dark Swarm is steady close range AoE, Drag adds 160 and a stun, and Paralyzing Enzymes cuts target healing by 50 percent.

good_into.why: Drag stuns and pulls a backliner out of position, and Isolation silences and blinds one target for a pick.
Paralyzing Enzymes cuts healing received by 50 percent on the dragged target and Drag can pull the healer away from his team.
Brushstalker and Burrow give mobility, Drag grabs a retreating hero, and Isolation slows.
Brushstalker is a stealthed global style travel tool, so he gets to fights and objectives across the map quickly.
Burrow is invulnerable for 2 seconds and Adaptation heals the damage taken over 4 seconds.

bad_into.why: Silence or stun during Drag cancels it, and Adaptation and Burrow are his only dodge tools.
Low hero damage output and a drag that cannot move heavy targets far make him poor at breaking a front line.
He has to walk into the poke and lacks a long range answer, though Essence healing helps.
Dark Swarm and Drag do not generate enough sustained pressure to overcome wide healing.

wants_from_team: Follow up damage after his Drag
Vision of bush paths and objectives
A carry to benefit from the picks he sets up
gives_team: Pick potential with Drag and Isolation
Healing reduction on the focus target
Camp clear and siege through Dark Swarm
weaknesses: Drag is cancelled by stun or silence
Needs Essence to keep sustain up
Depends on teammates to capitalise on picks
evidence: Drag, Dark Swarm, Burrow, Isolation, Adaptation, Essence Collection text
Paralyzing Enzymes, Lurker Strain, Pack Leader, Apex Predator talents
Measured: win rate 0.516, hero damage 1466 per minute, siege 6414, 33.5 seconds of CC applied per game, 2200 games
owner_notes: A bruiser who clears waves and offlanes before the objective to pull the other offlaner away, then burrows into the objective with the team and turns a 4v4 into a 5v4 with his global. If the other offlaner does not contest him he keeps pushing while the team stalls, and it is better still when a camp is timed to push with him.
flex_roles: Offlaner who pulls the other offlaner away
